results.title: Dune
results.overview: Paul Atreides, a brilliant and gifted young man born into a great destiny beyond his understanding, must travel to the most dangerous planet in the universe to ensure the future of his family and his people.

results.title: Dune: Part Two
results.overview: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family.

results.name: Dune: Prophecy
results.overview: Ten thousand years before the ascension of Paul Atreides, two Harkonnen sisters combat forces that threaten the future of humankind.

results.title: Dune
results.overview: In the year 10,191, the most precious substance in the universe is the spice Melange.
